interpretation: The released PDB training preprocessing applies ExcludedLigands by NONPOLYMER residue code; ZN/CA/MG are not rejected by this particular filter, unlike NA/CL. Other structure/chain filters still apply.
training_data_limit: This source audit does not establish the actual ion examples/counts used to train the released Boltz-2 checkpoint.
affinity_scope: The Boltz-2 paper states that its affinity module does not explicitly handle cofactors including ions/water/multimeric binding partners. This pilot tests structure cofolding only.
